kept.q: A line passes through the point (-2, 3) and has gradient -1/2. Find the equation of the line.
kept.explanation: Using y - 3 = -1/2(x - (-2)) gives y - 3 = -1/2 x - 1, so y = -1/2 x + 2, which rearranges to x + 2y = 4.
kept.pidgin: Make you put point (-2, 3) and gradient -1/2 inside formula y - y1 = m(x - x1). E go give you y - 3 = -1/2(x + 2). When you expand and rearrange am, e go come be x + 2y = 4.

kept.q: Find the gradient of a line that is perpendicular to the line joining A(1, -2) and B(5, 6).
kept.explanation: Gradient of AB = (6-(-2))/(5-1) = 8/4 = 2. The perpendicular gradient is the negative reciprocal, which is -1/2.

kept.q: A triangle has vertices P(2, 3), Q(6, 3), and R(2, 8). Calculate the length of the hypotenuse QR of this right-angled triangle.
kept.explanation: QR connects (6,3) and (2,8), so its length is sqrt((6-2)^2+(3-8)^2) = sqrt(16+25) = sqrt(41). PQ and PR are the two shorter sides meeting at the right angle at P.
kept.pidgin: Use distance formula between points Q(6,3) and R(2,8). E go give you square root of (6-2)^2 plus (3-8)^2, wey be square root of 16 + 25. Na so you go get sqrt(41).

kept.q: The line 3x - 2y + 6 = 0 crosses the x-axis at point A and the y-axis at point B. Find the distance AB.
kept.explanation: Setting y=0 gives x=-2, so A(-2,0). Setting x=0 gives y=3, so B(0,3). Distance AB = sqrt((0-(-2))^2+(3-0)^2) = sqrt(4+9) = sqrt(13).

kept.q: A line has x-intercept 4 and y-intercept -6. Find the equation of this line in the form ax + by + c = 0.
kept.explanation: The line passes through (4,0) and (0,-6), giving gradient (−6−0)/(0−4) = 3/2. Using y - 0 = 3/2(x - 4) leads to 2y = 3x - 12, which rearranges to 3x - 2y - 12 = 0.
